cache_policy: Identical existing raw Gradle cache; empty per-run generated source/wiki cache. OS/page/network caches not reset.
common_instructions:
请用中文回答，并给出支持关键结论的可复核出处，明确版本与不确定性。
本次只调查原版机制。不要读取既有调查报告、聊天历史、个人记忆或其他实验目录；不要启动子代理或游戏客户端/服务器。可在当前工作目录存放临时资料，其他本地文件只读。
study_type: Exploratory 3-arm, 3-repeat experiment on one paired Minecraft research task
native_context_metric: maximum per-response input_tokens from native token_count last_token_usage, not cumulative input_tokens
visible_text_metric: Sum of model-visible tool response text tokenized with o200k_base; proxy only, not GPT-6.1 tokenizer claim

noise_audit.sampling: one random token location per equal token-population stratum, fixed seed

classes.O: necessary retrieval, provenance and tool-use overhead

noise_audit.precision: human/model annotation estimate; report both I and I+F, not exact full-transcript percentages

quality.rubric: Frozen 100-point rubric: 90 factual, 10 evidence; two independent GPT-6.1 Sol high scorers with shuffled case IDs
quality.scope: Created independently while trials were starting, before reading their final answers; no scoring criteria changed after results

excluded_from_trial_cost: setup, failed authentication preflight, reference construction, scoring, noise audit, report generation
limitations: Only one paired topic and n=3 per group
OS page cache, remote HTTP cache, prompt caching and backend scheduling not reset
3 concurrent independent runs per wave; wall time includes local resource contention and network
Generic system/user skills common to all arms remain available; project Minecraft skill is only injected in A
Filesystem separation and explicit no-cross-reading instruction, not a hard read-isolation container
Answer references and output formats can partially reveal route despite shuffled labels
Token proxy is o200k_base, actual GPT-6.1 native counters reported separately
